scope: One explicitly authorized preview-branded provider delivery probe to one named recipient. No booking, money operation or production email activation.

recipient.authorization: Exact recipient supplied by Kye in chat for the prepared single-email test.

confirmation.source: Kye confirmed in chat after the single test send.

sender.verification: Authenticated Domains view showed verified and ready to send before submission.

render.sourceHtmlMeaning: Hash of application-generated HTML before Resend editor import, not a hash of delivered MIME/HTML.
render.sentCtaCheckedFrom: Rendered sent-email preview iframe link href.
render.providerTransformation: HTML imported into Resend template editor; the provider converted its markup and prefixed the test subject. Delivered bytes are not claimed identical to the application render.

send.mechanism: Authenticated Resend unpublished-template Test email action
send.eventTimePrecision: Provider UI minute-resolution display; not an independently retrieved UTC event timestamp.
send.duplicateGuard: One Send test submission was journaled before the action; no resend after the pending state. One matching new record was visible in the sent list. Dashboard does not expose an operator-supplied idempotency key.

access.existingPreviewCredential: Vercel metadata confirms one preview-scoped sensitive RESEND_API_KEY. Its value is not readable; no value was obtained or changed.
access.authenticatedProviderFallback: Secure GitHub sign-in succeeded and showed the existing Resend account. The provider-native test route was used without creating an API key.

limitations: The recipient confirms receipt in Junk and successful navigation to the DriveDrop home page. Inbox placement is not passed; the cause of Junk placement is not established. The exact destination URL was not reported by the recipient; the sent CTA href was independently checked above.
This proves the exercised sender/domain and provider-template delivery. It does not exercise the deployed application RESEND_API_KEY or sendTransactionalEmail path.
Lifecycle notification delivery, failure/retry handling and production-scoped email acceptance remain open.
The genuine Stripe balance_insufficient reversal failure/retry remains UNVERIFIED.

providerInsights.source: Authenticated Resend Insights tab for the existing single message; read-only follow-up after recipient confirmation.
providerInsights.warning: Ensure link URLs match sending domain
providerInsights.providerExplanation: Mismatched link and sending domains can trigger spam filters.
providerInsights.interpretation: The provider flags the preview URL mismatch as a possible filtering issue. This is not proof of the recipient provider’s reason for Junk placement.
